exclusion_reason: The i386 engine has only a bounded integer entry probe, so tail-call dispatch, exnref unwinding, and relaxed SIMD have no engine to attach to and no portability fallback has been measured.
promotion_trigger: Promote when a translated block dispatches by tail call, a guest exception unwinds through exnref, and packed SIMD executes, each with a verified fallback where the feature is flagged or absent.
expected_failing_assertion: The execution-substrate suite cannot dispatch, unwind, and execute SIMD without wasm-stack growth or a cross-browser divergence.
active_gate_evidence: The product records tail-call, exnref, and relaxed-SIMD availability as upstream capability evidence only.
procedure: Detect tail-call, exnref, and relaxed-SIMD support on each required browser profile.
Run a dispatch, exception-unwind, and packed-SIMD microprogram and compare against the strict and legacy fallback path.
pass_criterion: Dispatch, unwinding, and SIMD match the reference machine state.
A missing feature selects the declared fallback rather than diverging.
